email_subject: Application - Customer Success Manager at Semactic
email_body:
Dear Semactic team,

I'm writing to apply for the Customer Success Manager role. What caught my attention is Semactic's focus on turning SEO and GEO data into measurable results for marketing teams — that's exactly the kind of work I do every day.

At Episto I help clients rank for the searches their buyers make, from keyword research and technical SEO to local SEO and link building. As a freelancer, I brought in a construction company through a referral, led the discovery meeting and built a full growth proposal. I also ran a self-funded Google Ads test for a kids' bike brand that earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks, and I presented the results to their team. I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level.

I have my own car, so the trip to your Louvain-La-Neuve office is no problem. In the first weeks I'd get to know your clients' goals and map out clear action plans for adoption and retention. I'd welcome a conversation to discuss how I can contribute.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

Dear Semactic team,

When I saw that Semactic is looking for a Customer Success Manager to help clients turn SEO and GEO data into measurable results, I knew this was a role where I could make an immediate impact. I've spent the last years doing exactly that: helping businesses rank for the searches their buyers make and showing them the numbers behind it.

At Episto, I run keyword research, technical SEO, local SEO and link building for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients. As a freelancer, I brought in a construction company through a referral, led the discovery meeting and built a full growth proposal covering their website, Google Business Profile, regional Google Ads and social media. I also ran a self-funded Google Ads test for a kids' bike brand that earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks, and I presented the results to their team.

What draws me to Semactic is the combination of a powerful SaaS platform with expert support — that's the kind of environment where I thrive. I'm comfortable managing multiple client projects with different stakeholders, from business to tech to C-level, and I have a strong interest in AI and digital innovation. I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level. I have my own car, so the trip to your Louvain-La-Neuve office is no problem.

In the first weeks, I would focus on understanding your clients' goals and building clear, measurable action plans to drive adoption and retention. I'd love to talk about how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

# Baver Ok
SEO & GEO strategy · AI search visibility · Client management · Google Ads

English (fluent) · Turkish (native) · Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+)

## SUMMARY
I help clients turn SEO and GEO data into measurable results. At Episto I run keyword research, technical SEO and local SEO for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients, and as a freelancer I sell AI search visibility and SEO services, leading discovery meetings and building growth proposals. I built kxp.be with GEO for AI search and track KPIs in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console. My tango teaching years taught me to build trust and take ownership. I speak Dutch at B1/A2+ and have a very good level of English. I want to structure client success in a fast-growing SaaS scale-up.

## PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

### Junior Digital Marketer – Episto (Remote), 03/2026 – Present
- Run keyword research, local and mobile SEO and link building for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients
- Track KPIs (rankings, traffic, CTR) in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console and report on results
- **#4 on page 1** of Google Turkey for "PDKS" (access-control software), as part of the agency team
- Support a WooCommerce webshop ([proteinbox.com.tr](https://proteinbox.com.tr)) with catalogue, product content and conversion pages

### Freelance Digital Marketer – [baverok.com](https://baverok.com), 09/2026 – Present
- Sell AI search visibility, SEO, website and marketing automation services, with a free site check as the first step in each sales conversation
- Brought in a construction company through a referral, led the discovery meeting and built a full growth proposal covering the website, Google Business Profile, regional Google Ads and social media
- **4.57% CTR and 53 clicks** from a self-funded Google Ads test in Belgium and the Netherlands for a kids' bike brand: built two Dutch landing pages, chose buyer-intent keywords and presented the results to their team

### Web & SEO Specialist – Knowledge Experts ([KXP](https://kxp.be)), 01/2024 – 02/2026
- Built [kxp.be](https://kxp.be) single-handedly: WordPress, on-page SEO, GEO for AI search, in English, Dutch and French
- Analysed SEO performance and reported results to clients with Search Console and Google Analytics
- **#3 on Google** for "Belgian chess prodigy" with [mirook.com](https://mirook.com), a young chess player's personal-brand site, through technical SEO audits and schema markup
- Delivered client websites end to end, from site structure and content to social media integration

## PROJECTS & PRODUCTS

### PupSmart – AI dog-care app on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.momoco.pupsmart)
- Designed, built and launched an Android app with a potty predictor, a toxic-food scanner and AI health insights based on each dog's 7-day activity log
- Published it under my own label, MomoCo: free with ads, with premium AI features for subscribers

### AI job-search assistant
- Built an AI tool that collects job postings from VDAB, LinkedIn and EURES, scores each one for fit and drafts a tailored CV and cover letter, as a working example of marketing automation

## SKILLS
- **SEO & marketing:** SEO strategy, AI search (GEO/AEO), keyword research, technical, on-page, local and mobile SEO, SEO audits, schema markup, link building, Google Ads Search, content marketing, WooCommerce
- **Growth & sales:** client discovery meetings, offers and proposals, lead generation, landing pages, A/B testing
- **Data & tools:** GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Microsoft Clarity, WordPress/Elementor, HTML/CSS, Odoo, Canva, Claude/ChatGPT
